record.name: Platform
record.purpose: The standards this group works to.

says: Two isolated stores, Alice's laptop and her enrolled desktop, with no carrier bound: the Team is founded with local and peer carriers only. The laptop founds the Team, registers its knowledge source and commits two revisions, then stages a complete package of both by peer; the desktop verifies controls then bodies and commits it. The desktop undertakes custody of exactly that inventory for storage generation 1 and acknowledges holding each object at generation 1; the laptop records the desktop, as its peer, undertaking the same objects at generation 1. The desktop then stages the same inventory back as a complete package and the laptop's accept of it verifies and commits, reconstructing exactly the permitted inventory from the peer alone. What must not happen: any provider or network effect beyond the peer route, a commitment that omits the storage generation it assumes, an acknowledgment of objects that were not promised, or a reconstruction holding more or less than the inventory.
